assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: custom editorial illustration for CloverTools daily entertainment note, a small website sidebar artwork. A single emerald four-leaf clover made from folded paper floats above two small blank ivory fortune-paper slips, surrounded by a restrained orbital ellipse, a small crescent and scattered tiny geometric stars. Flat vector illustration with exquisite cut-paper silhouettes, very slight print grain, balanced asymmetrical composition, confident large shapes and generous margins. Dark ink navy-green background #142b2a, clover emerald #559c7d and pale mint #b9dcc4, restrained warm gold #c9a96e and cream #f4eddb. Wide landscape composition approximately 3:2, designed to remain readable as a 240px-wide card image. Calm, poetic and bespoke, not an app icon, not a logo, no frame. No text, no lettering, no numerals, no watermark, no gradients, no photorealism, no glossy 3D.
assets.inspection: Accepted after visual inspection: four-leaf clover, paper slips, dark green field, no text/watermark.
